profile.subject: a cream golden retriever dog
profile.styleHints: cream-white long fluffy coat, floppy ears, black nose, pink tongue, gentle smile

cycle.prompt: Same cream golden retriever dog in strict side profile facing right, one eye visible, 4-frame walk cycle with legs alternating trot, tail wagging slightly, fluffy cream coat, floppy ear, black nose, same size in every frame, 4 equal columns with wide magenta gaps, horizontal sprite sheet

profile.idlePrompt: Pose: standing in side view facing right, four paws grounded, head up, mouth open with tongue out, tail relaxed

rest.label: Sit Rest
rest.prompt: Pose: sitting upright on hind legs, front paws straight, head facing right, tongue out panting happily

sleep.label: Curl Nap
sleep.prompt: Pose: curled on side with paws tucked, eyes closed, fluffy tail over nose, breathing slow

voice.label: Friendly Bark
voice.prompt: Pose: standing alert facing right, mouth wide open barking, ears perked, tail wagging high

trick.label: Shake Paw
trick.prompt: Pose: sitting and lifting right front paw high to shake, head tilted, tongue out, tail wagging

lines: Hi I'm Pakkun let's be friends!
I love sunny days in the grass
My tail wags just for you
I will stay right beside you
You make my heart feel sunny

facts.text: Golden Retrievers are friendly, gentle dogs that love families and kids.
They are very smart and easy to train, and love to learn new tricks.
They love swimming and fetching, with a thick coat that sheds water.
